## Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed. Please also include relevant motivation and context.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue in a skill)
- [ ] New skill (non-breaking addition of a new FiveM specialist skill)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing behavior to change)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Validation

- [ ] I have run `python scripts/validate_skills.py` locally and it passes
- [ ] My changes preserve the required standalone invariants
- [ ] (If adding a skill) I have included the skill in `skills-manifest.json` and updated the `skill_count`

## Review checklist

- [ ] I have verified any new FiveM APIs against the official docs
- [ ] I have kept the instructions concise and focused on engineering rules
- [ ] I have not added duplicate context that belongs in `AGENTS.md`
